create_lfm2vl_model: create an LFM2-VL vision-language model with vision tower, projector, and language model components
run_lfm2vl_forward: run inference on an LFM2-VL model given input IDs, positions, and a forward batch
get_image_feature: get image features from multimodal data items through the vision tower and projector
pad_input_ids: pad input IDs with multimodal token placeholders for vision-language processing
load_lfm2vl_weights: load HuggingFace weights into an LFM2-VL model by mapping vision, projector, and language model weight prefixes
